parameters.excerpt: All fields are optional except for M, S, U, and BPFRZ. All unimplemented fields are read-only 0, while all implemented fields are writable.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses which optional control fields in mctrctl (such as RASEMU, STE, MTE, LCOFIFRZ, and transfer type filter bits) are implemented as writable versus read-only zero.

parameters.excerpt: It is implementation-specific which DEPTH value(s) are supported.

parameters.excerpt: MISP is read-only 0 when not implemented.

parameters.excerpt: An implementation that supports cycle counting must implement CCV and all CCM bits, but may implement 0..4 exponent bits in CCE. Unimplemented CCE bits are read-only 0.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses the number of CCE exponent bits (between 0 and 4) to implement in ctrdata; unimplemented bits are read-only zero.
